ftl.drone: tone sine 44 50 6 0.4; noise 0.3 0.08; env 2 0 2.5; loop on
air.hiss: tone off; noise 0.55 0.82; env 0.3 0 0.5; loop on
air.refill: tone off; noise 0.3 0.5; env 1.2 0 1.5; loop on
alarm.lowair: tone square 880 880 0 0.5; env 0.01 0 0.15; pulse 2 0.25; loop on
alarm.breach: tone square 620 880 0.45 0.5; env 0.01 0 0.25; pulse 1.1 0.85; loop on
engine.hum: tone square 55 55 0 0.3; noise 0.35 0.12; env 0.6 0 0.8; loop on
